architecture.memory: one-head gated delta rule, rank 32, 3 position-tagged lags, byte-level
architecture.selection: seed 9300, 150000 exposure bytes, probe role (50000 bytes), 6 configurations per arm (equal budgets); the confirmatory phase never re-selects

registration.confidence_level_note: each primary uses a two-sided Student-t interval over seed-paired differences at 1 - 0.05/family_size
registration.thresholds_status: final: unchanged from the provisional values (no change after screening, see screening_rounds)

probe.validity: instrument validity: the untrained compiled memory must reach recall >= 0.1 at L=0 (full state) and the untrained random one <= 0.05; otherwise P3 is not evaluated as met

findings: GDM arms were tuned only on (b0, gamma0) with lr fixed at 1e-3 while the GRU arms chose lr 2e-3..3e-3: an unequal search that favoured the GRU arms and confounded forgetting with lr. Grids rewritten to 6 configurations per arm, each including lr.

Probe with 8 five-letter-value lines (96 writes into a 32-dimensional memory) gave recall ~0 for every arm, including the untrained compiled memory at 8 facts: over capacity. Probe resized to 4 facts with 3-letter values; distractor lengths 0,10,30,100 (100 and 300 gave ~0 for the untrained compiled memory too). The registered P3 length is 10, chosen from the untrained positive control only (recall 0.12-0.38 at L=10 against 0.00-0.03 for the random negative control), before any trained-arm result of round 2.
Round 1 reading, exploratory: GDM-wsp was 0.019 BPB worse than GDM-random on all 3 seeds (same lr), the GRU arm 0.117 better than GDM-wsp (lr confounded).
Equal 6-configuration grids including lr; chosen settings written to `chosen` above and frozen for the confirmatory run.

Exploratory reading (3 seeds, dev role, 300000 bytes): C1 (wsp over random, same lr 0.003) BPB gain 0.0144 (seeds 0.015, 0.011, 0.018), below the 0.02 floor; P1 bytes ratio 0.79 (0.84, 0.935, 0.608); P3 and P4 effects about zero (recall after training is near zero for every arm although the untrained compiled memory has recall 0.108 at L=10: training did not strengthen the memory); C2 (wsp over memory-off) 0.008 +- 0.011; C3 (wsp vs GRU) -0.069 (the plain GRU is better).

No threshold was changed after seeing results: a floor lowered to 0.014 would be fitting to the observation. Caveat recorded: P3's floor 0.15 exceeds the untrained compiled memory's own recall at L=10 (0.108), so P3 can pass only if training strengthens the memory beyond its compiled prior.
